exercises.title: U6 听力·对话 Talking About Recycling
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: Tom, what do you do with your empty bottles and cans?
Tom: I put them in the recycling bin near my house.
Mia: That's great. Do you recycle paper too?
Tom: Yes, and I use both sides of every sheet before I recycle it.
Mia: I should do the same. I usually just throw everything away.
Tom: You could start with plastic. Plastic takes hundreds of years to break down.
Mia: Really? Then I'll bring a reusable bag for shopping from now on.
Tom: Good idea. Small changes like that really help the Earth.
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 问 Tom 如何处理空瓶和易拉罐;Tom 放进家附近的回收箱,纸张也双面使用后再回收;Mia 平时都扔掉,打算照做;Tom 建议先从塑料开始,因为塑料要数百年才分解;Mia 决定以后购物用可重复使用的袋子;Tom 说这样的小改变真的有助于地球。

exercises.title: U6 听力·短文 What Is Smog
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The word smog comes from the words smoke and fog.
It describes the dirty air that covers many busy cities.
Long ago, smog was mainly caused by burning coal at home.
Today, most smog comes from traffic and factories.
Smog is dangerous because it can cause serious breathing problems.
exercises.translation_cn: smog 一词来自 smoke 和 fog;它描述覆盖许多繁忙城市的脏空气;很久以前,雾霾主要由家庭烧煤造成;如今大多数雾霾来自交通和工厂;雾霾很危险,会引起严重的呼吸问题。

questions.stem: Where does the word 'smog' come from?
What does smog describe?
options: The dirty air over busy cities.
Clean air on a high mountain.
A kind of cloud above the sea.

questions.stem: What mainly caused smog long ago?
What causes most smog today?
Why is smog dangerous?
options: It cools the whole city down.
It can cause serious breathing problems.

exercises.title: U6 听力·对话 Saving Energy at Home
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Dad: Lily, why have you unplugged the television?
Lily: Our teacher said devices in stand-by mode still use power.
Dad: Really? I always thought turning it off was enough.
Lily: No. Electricity keeps leaking from them, even when they look off.
Dad: So we waste power every night without knowing it.
Lily: Yes. If we remove the plug, we save energy and money.
Dad: That makes sense. Let's unplug the computer too.
Lily: Great. Small habits like this help fight global warming.
exercises.translation_cn: 爸爸问 Lily 为什么把电视拔了插头;Lily 说老师讲过待机状态的设备仍在耗电;爸爸原以为关掉就够了;Lily 说即使看起来关了,电仍在漏出;所以每晚都在不知不觉中浪费电;拔掉插头就能省电省钱;爸爸赞同,提议电脑也拔掉;Lily 说这样的小习惯有助于应对全球变暖。

questions.stem: Why did Lily unplug the television?
options: Devices in stand-by mode still use power.
It was making too much noise.

questions.stem: What did Dad think was enough?
What keeps happening even when a device looks off?
options: It makes a very loud noise.

questions.stem: What should they do to save energy?
options: Remove the plug from the socket.

questions.stem: What do small habits like this help do?

exercises.title: U6 听力·短文 Protecting Sharks
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: For many years, people were very afraid of sharks.
A famous film made them believe that all sharks were dangerous.
Because of this fear, fishermen killed millions of sharks.
In fact, sharks harm people only by accident.
Today, more and more people want to protect them from extinction.
exercises.translation_cn: 多年来,人们非常害怕鲨鱼;一部著名电影让他们相信所有鲨鱼都很危险;由于这种恐惧,渔民杀死了数百万条鲨鱼;事实上,鲨鱼伤人只是出于意外;如今越来越多的人想要保护它们免于灭绝。

questions.stem: How did people feel about sharks for many years?
options: They were very afraid of them.

questions.stem: What did the famous film make people believe?
What did fishermen do because of this fear?
options: They fed the sharks every day.

questions.stem: Why do sharks attack people, in fact?
options: They harm people only by accident.
Because people are their main food.

questions.stem: What do more people want to do today?

exercises.title: U6 听力·对话 A Visit to a Nature Reserve
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Reporter: Lin Feng, can you tell us a little about this nature reserve?
Lin Feng: Of course. It was established in the year 2000 and is very large.
Reporter: What is the biggest problem you face here?
Lin Feng: Large areas of wetland have been damaged by human activity.
Reporter: How does that affect the plants and animals?
Lin Feng: It harms them, and we have also seen more droughts and floods.
Reporter: And what is your team doing to help?
Lin Feng: We protect and restore the land and find sustainable ways to farm.
exercises.translation_cn: 记者请林峰介绍这个自然保护区;林峰说它建立于2000年,面积很大;记者问最大的问题是什么;林峰说大片湿地被人类活动破坏;这影响了那里的动植物,还出现了更多旱灾和洪水;记者问团队在做什么;林峰说他们保护并修复土地,寻找可持续的耕作方式。

exercises.title: U6 听力·短文 A Green Tip
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip to help the Earth every day.
Try to reduce the amount of energy you use at home.
Turn off the lights when you leave a room.
Unplug any device that you are not using.
These small actions save power and help slow down global warming.
